# Gambo

> > Gambo is the world's first AI Game Vibe Coding Agent that enables no-code game creation through AI-powered asset generation and development tools.

Gambo, operated by Dora Platform Pte. Ltd., provides a credit-based AI platform for building games without coding. Users can generate game assets, leverage pre-built templates like Naruto: Ninja Adventure and Tank Battle, and access both free and pro subscription tiers for game development.

## Key Topics

- AI game builder
- No-code game development
- Vibe coding agent
- Credits system
- Game asset generation
- Subscription plans (Free & Pro)
- Image generation
- Gambo platform
- Dora Platform Pte. Ltd.
- Usage rates
- Game templates
- AI-powered development
- Discord community
